generationPrompt: Create ONE transparent RGBA logo sprite for ONE dealer. Exactly four matched assets, 2 columns x 2 rows, generous transparent gutters, no grid/labels/panels. Top left a bold compact mark for light backgrounds; top right its matching white inverse for dark/red backgrounds; bottom left horizontal full wordmark in dark/brand colours; bottom right identical full wordmark in white. Use flat smooth solid ink, crisp substantial strokes, no textures, shadows, glow or background. Compact mark must be legible at 32px; simplify secondary detail. Faithful redraw of supplied SINO HUAP / HUAPENG identity: preserve the navy angular H motif crossed by a gold diagonal swoosh and green leaf. Compact mark is this bold H/leaf/swoosh, using navy gold green on light and white with tiny gold/green accents on dark. Full exact text 'SINO HUAP' beneath or beside the H motif, retaining original navy geometric uppercase lettering; include recognizable Chinese '华鹏' above or to right as in reference only if accurately reproduced. White inverse text. No added company slogans. Colour motif should remain visible at small size.
